title: Delete only the sample record
summary: The delete API removes one document by its id.

Explain the example for delete only the sample record

blocks.text: The delete API removes one document by its id. Its scope is much narrower than deleting a whole index.

Use a local Elasticsearch 8+ instance with Kibana Dev Tools. Paste the HTTP request examples into that console. Use only the cma-books practice index. This website does not connect to an Elasticsearch server.
Read the code step by step

items: The path includes both the index and the /_doc/1 document address.
Removing the document suffix would change the target scope, which is why the full path must be checked.

blocks.text: The named sample document is removed. A later get reports it missing.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Check the path before deletion. DELETE cma-books-mapped without /_doc/1 would target the index itself.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Identify the exact id being removed.
